name: Factory OEE
overview: Measure availability, performance and quality as a combined KPI.
practice: Use consistent production-time definitions for each shift.

name: Production Capacity
overview: Estimate throughput from cycle time and available operating hours.
practice: Allow for maintenance, changeovers and expected downtime.

name: Manufacturing Cost
overview: Separate direct material, labor and overhead components.
practice: Compare cost per accepted unit rather than all units started.

name: Downtime Tracking
overview: Classify interruptions and their impact on output.
practice: Record reason codes consistently for actionable trends.

name: Production Scheduling
overview: Plan sequencing, capacity and delivery commitments.
practice: Account for bottlenecks, setups and work in progress.

name: Labor Productivity
overview: Compare output relative to paid production time.
practice: Avoid optimizing speed while ignoring quality and safety.

name: Quality Control
overview: Understand inspection, process capability and defect classification.
practice: Define measurable specifications before selecting tests.

name: Defect Rate
overview: Calculate rejected units and first-pass yield.
practice: Distinguish scrap, rework and accepted units.

name: Industrial Safety
overview: Review hazard identification, training and prevention.
practice: Follow applicable local occupational safety requirements.

name: Machine Maintenance
overview: Plan preventive intervals and condition checks.
practice: Use downtime history and manufacturer instructions.

name: ETP & Effluent
overview: Understand wastewater flow, treatment stages and discharge parameters.
practice: Check locally applicable permits and lab-based test methods.

name: Industrial Water Use
overview: Measure water intensity and reuse opportunities.
practice: Differentiate intake, recirculation and discharged quantities.

name: Packaging Cost
overview: Estimate packaging material and process cost per shipment.
practice: Include handling, wastage and transport impacts.

name: Plastic Recycling
overview: Understand sorting, polymer grades and reprocessing steps.
practice: Check contamination and material-traceability requirements.

name: Extended Producer Responsibility
overview: Learn EPR roles, collection systems and compliance concepts.
practice: Refer to jurisdiction-specific obligations and effective rules.

name: E-Waste Management
overview: Review collection, dismantling and safe disposal approaches.
practice: Use licensed handlers for hazardous components.

name: Scrap Materials
overview: Understand material recovery factors and market quotations.
practice: Check grade, purity, moisture and transport costs.

name: Carbon Footprint
overview: Explore emissions accounting scopes and activity data.
practice: Use transparent factors with source and year.

name: Farming Operations
overview: Plan crop inputs, land use and seasonal tasks.
practice: Track yield, weather and field conditions separately.

name: Livestock Management
overview: Understand feeding, breeding and herd productivity records.
practice: Distinguish per-animal measures from farm totals.

name: Fisheries & Aquaculture
overview: Explore stocking density, feed conversion and water checks.
practice: Monitor species-specific water and animal-health requirements.

name: Crop Yield
overview: Estimate harvest yield per area under stated assumptions.
practice: Separate measured yield from modeled forecasts.

name: Food Processing
overview: Understand process flow, batch handling and hygiene controls.
practice: Use hazard analysis appropriate to the product and market.

name: Cold Chain
overview: Plan temperature-sensitive storage and transport monitoring.
practice: Record excursion durations and validated limits.

name: Agricultural Equipment
overview: Compare machinery capacity, maintenance and operator needs.
practice: Evaluate total operating cost, not only purchase price.

name: Factory Automation
overview: Explore sensor-driven control, PLCs and production integration.
practice: Prioritize safety interlocks and maintainable interfaces.

name: Industrial Robotics
overview: Review repeatability, payload and integration requirements.
practice: Evaluate safeguarding and integration downtime.

name: Factory Energy
overview: Understand electricity use per output unit and peak demand.
practice: Normalize comparisons for production mix and shifts.

name: Supply Chain KPIs
overview: Measure lead time, supplier reliability and inventory turns.
practice: Keep receipt dates and performance definitions consistent.

name: Industrial Data Analytics
overview: Design useful dashboards with consistent plant metrics.
practice: Validate source data and abnormal readings before decisions.
